projects.title: Fieldday
projects.alt: Two fictional Fieldday food campaign posters in cream and pink on a stone wall
projects.description: A concept food brand that celebrates simple ingredients. A playful identity pairing confident lettering, natural photography and a warm voice.
projects.challenge: How can good food feel approachable through design?
projects.approach: A visual system combining open space, ingredient photography and concise messages that work across packaging and campaigns.

projects.title: Velora
projects.alt: Concept visual direction for the fictional Velora brand
projects.description: An exploration of a calm digital presence for a care brand, with a clear content hierarchy and an easy path from introduction to discovery.
projects.challenge: Translate the character of a brand into a simple browsing experience.
projects.approach: Flexible page structures, generous product imagery and a visual sequence that balances the story with useful information.

projects.title: Nora
projects.alt: A concept presentation of the Nora visual identity on print materials
projects.description: An identity study with personality and flexibility. Applications that give room to typography and small details.
projects.challenge: Create a consistent identity across different media.
projects.approach: A focused palette, expandable print compositions and a clear visual voice that is easy to recognise.

aboutTitle: Good design starts with a good question.
about: I look for the idea that makes each project different, then build a clear visual language and experience around it.
From identity to website, I care about the connection between what a brand says and what people experience.

services.title: Visual identities
services.description: A considered identity that reflects your brand and creates a clear, consistent presence.

services.title: Website design
services.description: Thoughtful, easy-to-use websites that bring form and function together.

services.title: Digital experiences
services.description: Connected digital experiences, from the first idea to the interaction.

contactTitle: An idea in mind? Let’s give it form.
